package.name: armo_preload
package.description: libarmo_preload.so, loaded with LD_PRELOAD: catches ros_trace_*, rcl_wait, rcl_timer_fini, rclcpp construction functions, flux_trace_*, armo_span markers and, on request, CUDA driver and DDS write calls, and writes armo's shared memory file. Also the static interception library armo_intercept that the LTTng backend links.
